items.reason: Whole-set routing prints the set identifier, resolved Runtime path, and binding kind before the status table.
Header emission includes runs invoked inside the bound checkout.
The header compares checkout roots instead of the invocation directory, omitting subdirectory differences and reporting the wrong cwd with project overrides.
BoundDefault adds “binding recorded to current checkout” when the binding is recorded.
The old conditional “draining at bound checkout” output is removed.
Single-task AFK execution prints the current-checkout path without a Drain header.
The current-checkout line prints before the single-task HITL branch.
Whole-set completion prints one green “✓ <set>/<task> done” line.
Commit SHA or verified no-op detail prints immediately beneath the done line.
The old completion renderer is removed and successful task results print once.
Exhaustion that fails the task prints one red failed result while preserving the failed transition.
Exhaustion that leaves the task open prints the distinct red “out of agents (left open)” result.
Quota parking prints a yellow quota-paused result naming the preset.
Interrupted execution prints a yellow interrupted result.
Blocked and Deferred remain set-level reports without new Task result lines.
Attempt failure narration, exhausted-walk narration, and attempt breakdowns are preserved.
Header and result rendering preserves full text without ANSI escapes for redirected output.
Result lines use the existing TTY color handling and NO_COLOR suppression.
New header and result renderers write output without adding Work journal rows.

scores.rationale: Clear, focused rendering changes with useful regression tests, but incorrect cwd handling and missing coverage for that requirement limit correctness.
